SELECT s.*
, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance
FROM store s WHERE s.status like 'OPEN'
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND s.min_order_amount >= #{minPrice}
AND s.min_order_amount <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY distance
ORDER BY s.rating DESC
ORDER BY s.min_order_amount ASC
ORDER BY s.average_delivery_time ASC
